definitions.explanation: A person hired privately to investigate matters such as missing persons, cheating spouses, or corporate espionage.
A character who solves mysteries or crimes, especially in novels and media.

examples.japanese: {探偵|たんてい}を{雇|やと}って{調|しら}べてもらった。
examples.english: I hired a detective to investigate.

examples.japanese: {探偵|たんてい}{小説|しょうせつ}が{大好|だいす}きだ。
{私立|しりつ}{探偵|たんてい}が{事件|じけん}を{解決|かいけつ}した。
examples.english: The private detective solved the case.

notes:
FORMATION:
{探|たん} (search/investigate) + {偵|てい} (spy/scout)

TYPES:
・{私立|しりつ}{探偵|たんてい} - private detective
・{名|めい}{探偵|たんてい} - great/famous detective

COLLOCATIONS:
・{探偵|たんてい}を{雇|やと}う - to hire a detective
・{探偵|たんてい}に{依頼|いらい}する - to commission a detective
・{探偵|たんてい}{事務所|じむしょ} - detective agency

VERB FORM:
{探偵|たんてい}する - to investigate; to do detective work

CULTURAL NOTE:
{探偵|たんてい} in Japanese fiction is a popular genre, with famous characters like {名探偵|めいたんてい}コナン (Detective Conan).
